notes.title: Opening Theme "ME!" Released on Spotify & YouTube + itch.io page!
notes.notes:
Now that the "RAKKA: WAKE 01 - SOOT" Demo is officially available on Steam, we've also decided to release it on [url=https://the-paradox-music-team.itch.io/rakka-wake-01-soot]itch.io[/url]!

To celebrate, we've released the opening theme for the game: "ME!" on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6Sxk0VE3MvamPjmgvsXhaK?si=PYJCrgKIQQq9Oc7g4SWVWA]Spotify[/url] & [url=https://pascalpotatovandenbos.bandcamp.com/album/rakka-wake-01-opening-me]Bandcamp[/url], as well as published the full animation on [url=https://youtu.be/_ATlv3fsFL4?si=USNNjb8VV79EDBLH]YouTube[/url] in high quality! We hope you enjoy, and thank you for the support so far!
